Data.String: To atmosphere at a safe height

Typical of R-201A to R-201P: B to P are instrumented as R-201A (P-203). 1291 m3, 1033 m3 of broth, 323 K, design 2.5 / -0.3 barg, 150 C (D-016). A-201A: top entry, 160 kW, gearbox, double mechanical seal with a sterile barrier above headspace pressure.

NOT AERATED: anaerobic / microaerophilic fermentation, no sparger and no air train (D-019). Sterile N2 overlay at 0.3 barg: PIC-2041A on the vent back-pressure valve, PCV-2042A self-acting N2 make-up at 0.25 barg.

STERILE BOUNDARY: steam blocks (SS steam in, CD bleed) on medium, inoculum, lime, CIP supply, CIP return and harvest; sterile class SS316L inside (D-020). Lime is not sterile and crosses it when dosing (D-018).
TIC-2011A split range: TV-2011B LP steam (heat-up, lag phase), TV-2011A CW (D-017, D-031). Trips: I-201 TSHH-2012A, I-202 FSLL-2014A stop A-201A; I-203 LSHH-2032A closes XV-2034A; I-204 PALL-2043A.
F-201A isolated by XV-2043A and bypassed by XV-2044A during CIP; SIP steam at the head (through the spray line) and the bottom; PSE-2045A, PSV-2046A in piping/special-items.yaml (D-031).
